findings.title: Abort does not prove that the complete process tree is dead
findings.description: The Windows path invokes taskkill /T /F, but ignores its result and then only waits on the runner PID. The POSIX path sends SIGTERM to the process group, but after the runner wait/kill timeout it does not re-check or kill surviving descendants. A detached or signal-resistant worker can therefore continue after the harness records an abort, potentially retaining browser, SQLite, or output-root state.
findings.recommended_action: Make termination fail closed: record taskkill/kill-group status, enumerate and verify owned descendants are gone, and classify termination_unconfirmed as a hard invalid result. Add a supported-host test with a real surviving descendant rather than a cooperative fake.
findings.falsifier: A deterministic Windows/POSIX test and receipt proving every harness-owned descendant is absent after an abort, including the failure path where the runner exits before descendants do.

findings.title: Exact source-add markers are not scoped to the current account/run
findings.description: _source_add_abort_marker scans every JSONL file below run_root and returns the first exact value, but it does not require the event run_id, account_profile, or selected video ID to match the currently executing arm. Any stale file or another account's exact source-add event in a reused/shared run directory can abort the arm. Conversely, the test only proves exact string matching and does not exercise stale or cross-account logs.
findings.recommended_action: Pass the expected run nonce/account/cohort into marker detection and require the marker event envelope to match before aborting. Reject or quarantine any pre-existing JSONL under run_root before launch, and add stale-log, wrong-account, wrong-run, and nested per-video-error tests.
findings.falsifier: A clean-run invariant plus tests showing an exact marker from a prior run or different account is ignored while a matching current event aborts.

findings.title: Executable packet provenance has no fresh launch identity or clean runtime-root gate
findings.description: The packet fingerprints prepared artifacts, but does not bind execution to a newly created run directory or a packet launch nonce. execute_packet uses pair/arm/run without first requiring it to be absent/empty, and validation accepts a summary run_id generated by whatever summary is found rather than comparing it with packet-owned execution identity. A stale summary/event tree under the packet root can therefore be joined to a new invocation; packet and artifact edits in the shared worktree are also not protected by an immutable snapshot.
findings.recommended_action: Generate and persist a unique packet execution nonce before launch, require each run root to be newly created and empty, inject the nonce into the child, and require summary/receipt/event envelopes to match it. Refuse execution if any runtime artifact pre-exists or if packet/artifact fingerprints change after preparation.
findings.falsifier: A test that pre-populates pair-01/control/run with a completed summary/events tree and demonstrates execution refuses the root before launching, plus a cross-run nonce mismatch test.

findings.title: vph_valid is set before the full validity gate and can expose invalid numeric VPH
findings.description: execute_packet sets vph_valid to runner_status == completed and not aborted, then computes and writes numeric VPH before validate_arm checks event provenance, exact receipts, cleanup events, adaptive target-worker evidence, same-cohort receipt identity, and environment-mode settings. If any of those gates fails while the child returns a completed summary, the receipt still advertises vph_valid=true and a numeric VPH; validate_arm reports status failed but does not clear the value. This permits downstream consumers to treat a failed arm's VPH as valid.
findings.recommended_action: Compute VPH only after all arm and packet gates pass, or make the receipt validator authoritative and rewrite/normalize failed receipts to vph_valid=false, vph=null, and empty per-account VPH. Add tests where completion is true but cleanup, event provenance, adaptive scale-up, or environment same-settings validation fails.
findings.falsifier: A downstream contract that consumes only validate_arm.status and provably ignores receipt.vph_valid/vph, together with tests demonstrating no failed arm can be serialized with valid numeric VPH.

claim_ledger.claim: A source-add abort leaves no owned runtime descendants or shared handles behind.
claim_ledger.evidence: Termination results are ignored and tests use a cooperative fake process.
claim_ledger.verification_method: Static control-flow review and focused test inspection.
claim_ledger.falsifier: Real descendant termination verification on the supported host.
claim_ledger.action_allowed: Fix termination and add evidence before live use.

claim_ledger.claim: A receipt with vph_valid=true is a valid throughput result.
claim_ledger.evidence: The flag is assigned before validate_arm's full gate and is not cleared when that gate fails.
claim_ledger.falsifier: A complete consumer contract proving failed-arm numeric VPH is never consumed, or corrected receipt normalization.
claim_ledger.action_allowed: Do not promote numeric VPH until validity is fail-closed.
